card.title: Install Elchi as an app
card.iosTitle: Add Elchi to your Home Screen
card.iosBody: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only reach the app opened from the Home Screen. Adding takes 3 steps.
card.iosBodyDashboard: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only reach the app opened from the Home Screen. If you close this, the offer stays in Settings and Notifications.

inbox.desktop: Opens in its own window from the desktop or the Start menu.
inbox.phone: Opens in its own window with one tap from the Home Screen.

dashboard.desktop: Opens in its own window from the desktop. If you close this, the offer stays in Settings and Notifications.
dashboard.phone: Opens with one tap from the Home Screen. If you close this, the offer stays in Settings and Notifications.

hint.installed: Opened as an app on this device
hint.installedHere: Installed on this device — open the app from the home screen or desktop
hint.ios: On iPhone and iPad it is added to the Home Screen via Safari
hint.unsupported: This browser can't install it — open it in Chrome, Edge or Safari

ios.title: Add to Home Screen
ios.body: Elchi opens as a separate app and notifications reach your device — even when the app is closed.

share.title: Tap «Share»
share.hint: The square-and-arrow icon at the bottom of Safari (at the top on iPad)

add.title: Choose «Add to Home Screen»
add.hint: Scroll the list down — the item is in the middle of the menu

confirm.title: Tap «Add»
confirm.hint: The Elchi icon appears on the Home Screen — open the app from there

ios.safariOnly: Works only in Safari. If you opened the link in another browser, open it in Safari.

menuHint.title: Install from the browser menu
menuHint.body: Click the install icon in the address bar or «Install app» in the browser menu.
